example_scenarios.description: Scenario storico-difensivo ispirato a NotPetya: compromissione supply chain software/update, propagazione laterale e impatto wiper su organizzazioni pubbliche, logistica, trasporti, industria e servizi critici.

adversary.strategic_goal: degradare continuita' operativa, fiducia nei servizi e capacita' logistica

victim.mission: continuita' operativa e preservazione servizi essenziali

example_scenarios.name: Viasat KA-SAT satellite communications disruption
example_scenarios.description: Scenario storico-difensivo basato sull'attacco Viasat KA-SAT del 23-24 febbraio 2022: compromissione di infrastruttura di gestione SATCOM, distribuzione di wiper AcidRain verso modem e interruzione di comunicazioni satellitari in Ucraina con spillover europeo.

adversary.strategic_goal: degradare comunicazioni satellitari e supporto C2 durante fase cinetica

systems_abused: remote terminal update or control path

victim.organization_type: satellite communications provider and dependent public-private users
victim.mission: mantenere connettivita' SATCOM resiliente durante crisi

framework_sources.description: Knowledge base ATT&CK-like per sistemi spaziali, con matrice su Space Segment, Ground Segment e link di comunicazione.
Knowledge base globale di tattiche, tecniche e procedure avversarie basata su osservazioni reali.
Catalogo di tattiche e tecniche avversarie contro sistemi di intelligenza artificiale.
Framework e linguaggio comune per analizzare e rispondere a campagne di manipolazione informativa.
Conceptual framework for NATO MDO based on operational domains, DIME instruments, cross-domain integration, synchronized effects and orchestration.

gnss_spoofing.technique: Spacecraft Jamming / Ground Segment Jamming / Transmitted Data Manipulation
gnss_spoofing.trigger: Dipendenza GNSS o space link con coordinate incoerenti, jamming o spoofing.

gnss_spoofing.technique: T1565 Data Manipulation, T1499 Endpoint DoS, T1027 Obfuscated Files or Information
gnss_spoofing.trigger: Alterazione o degradazione di dati di navigazione, telemetry ingestion o servizi dipendenti.

gnss_spoofing.technique: Data poisoning, evasion of ML-based sensor fusion, model drift exploitation
gnss_spoofing.trigger: Pipeline di sensor fusion o anomaly detection che interpreta segnali GNSS manipolati.

communication_disruption.technique: Protocol Tunnelling, RF modification, Temporary loss to telecommand satellite
communication_disruption.trigger: Degrado comunicazioni satellitari, fallback incerto o perdita temporanea di link.

communication_disruption.technique: T1105 Ingress Tool Transfer, T1498 Network Denial of Service, T1489 Service Stop
communication_disruption.trigger: Interruzione o saturazione di servizi di comunicazione mission-critical.

software_exploit.technique: T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application, T1059 Command and Scripting Interpreter, T1027 Obfuscated Files or Information
software_exploit.trigger: Vulnerabilita' software, servizio esposto o exploit su backend operativo.

software_exploit.technique: Software vulnerabilities, Payload exploitation to execute commands
software_exploit.trigger: Software ground/space segment esposto o componente missione vulnerabile.

identity_compromise.technique: T1078 Valid Accounts, T1552 Unsecured Credentials, T1110 Brute Force
identity_compromise.trigger: Uso improprio credenziali, MFA bypass o account privilegiato compromesso.

identity_compromise.technique: Valid Credentials, Steal cryptographic keys, Forge Digital Certificates
identity_compromise.trigger: Credenziali o chiavi usate per telecommand, ground segment o federated mission.

supply_chain.technique: T1195 Supply Chain Compromise, T1588 Obtain Capabilities
supply_chain.trigger: Compromissione di dipendenze software, update channel, build system o vendor.

supply_chain.technique: Compromise Software Supply Chain, Compromise Hardware Supply Chain, Malicious supply chain capabilities
supply_chain.trigger: Dipendenze missione o componenti space segment/ground segment non affidabili.

supply_chain.technique: Publish poisoned datasets, compromise ML artifacts, malicious model dependency
supply_chain.trigger: Dataset, modello o pipeline AI/ML importati da fonte non verificata.

ot_cps.technique: T0831 Manipulation of Control, T0882 Theft of Operational Information, T0814 Denial of Service
ot_cps.trigger: Degrado OT/CPS, manipolazione controllo o interruzione servizi fisici.

data_poisoning.tactic: ML Attack Staging / ML Model Access / Impact
data_poisoning.technique: Data poisoning, evade model, manipulate training or runtime data
data_poisoning.trigger: Dati alterati in training, inference, decision support o sensor fusion.

data_poisoning.technique: T1565 Data Manipulation, T1005 Data from Local System
data_poisoning.trigger: Alterazione di dataset, log, telemetry o feature usate per decisioni operative.

disinformation.tactic: Plan / Prepare / Seed / Amplify / Manipulate / Evade / Assess
disinformation.technique: Narrative planning, persona/infrastructure preparation, content seeding, coordinated amplification, perception manipulation
disinformation.trigger: Operazione informativa coordinata o influenza cognitiva collegata allo scenario.

disinformation.technique: T1598 Phishing for Information, T1585 Establish Accounts, T1565 Data Manipulation
disinformation.trigger: Campagna informativa coordinata, narrativa manipolata o falsa evidenza pubblica.

disinformation.technique: Prompt injection, generated deceptive content, model output manipulation
disinformation.trigger: Uso di AI generativa per amplificare contenuti o manipolare percezione.

nato_cases.title: NotPetya-style supply-chain wiper sviluppato in ATHENA
nato_cases.description: Scenario storico-difensivo basato sul caso NotPetya: compromissione di un meccanismo di update software fidato, propagazione laterale e impatto distruttivo su servizi pubblici, logistica e continuita' operativa.

flow.label: Trusted update channel
flow.evidence: Compromissione del meccanismo di update software e distribuzione di codice malevolo tramite canale fidato.

flow.label: Endpoint infection
flow.evidence: Esecuzione su host enterprise e avvio della propagazione interna con elevata fiducia apparente.

flow.label: Credential and admin tooling abuse
flow.evidence: Uso di credenziali e strumenti amministrativi per muoversi rapidamente nella rete.

flow.label: Wiper / destructive outage
flow.evidence: Interruzione dei servizi, perdita operativa e necessita' di ripristino prioritizzato.

frameworkRows: T1195 Supply Chain Compromise / trusted update abuse
Credential material and administrative trust abused during propagation
Administrative tooling and internal trust relationships
Destructive wiper behavior and service outage
Prioritized business continuity and public/private coordination

case_scenarios.name: Trusted software update compromise
case_scenarios.summary: Compromissione del canale di aggiornamento di un software usato da organizzazioni ucraine e internazionali.
case_scenarios.athena_focus: Governance supply chain, asset dependency mapping, CTI correlation.

case_scenarios.name: Enterprise propagation and credential abuse
case_scenarios.summary: Propagazione interna tramite relazioni di fiducia, credenziali e strumenti amministrativi.

case_scenarios.name: Destructive wiper disguised as ransomware
case_scenarios.summary: Perdita di disponibilita' e integrita' dei sistemi con impatti operativi oltre il perimetro iniziale.
case_scenarios.athena_focus: Virtual impact mitigation and prioritized recovery.

case_scenarios.name: Global spillover and continuity pressure
case_scenarios.summary: Effetti a cascata su organizzazioni multinazionali, supply chain, logistica e servizi pubblici.
case_scenarios.athena_focus: Cross-domain incident cell and public/private coordination.

timeline.event: Destructive payload deployed through trusted software path.
Internal movement via credentials and administrative trust.
Widespread operational disruption and recovery pressure.

nato_cases.title: Viasat KA-SAT satellite communications disruption sviluppato in ATHENA
nato_cases.description: Scenario storico-difensivo basato sull'attacco Viasat KA-SAT del 23-24 febbraio 2022: compromissione di infrastruttura di gestione SATCOM, wiper AcidRain sui modem e interruzione di comunicazioni satellitari con spillover europeo.

flow.label: SATCOM management path
flow.evidence: Accesso o abuso del segmento di gestione terrestre collegato a terminali KA-SAT e modem SurfBeam.

flow.label: Modem fleet targeting
flow.evidence: Distribuzione o attivazione di logica distruttiva verso modem satellitari su larga scala.

flow.label: AcidRain-like wiper
flow.evidence: Modem resi inutilizzabili, perdita di connettivita' satellitare e necessita' di replacement/recovery.

flow.label: European service disruption
flow.evidence: Impatto su utenze civili e servizi dipendenti, inclusi sistemi energetici e comunicazioni operative.

frameworkRows: VPN appliance misconfiguration exploited to access trusted management segment
Use of trusted management access to issue modem management commands
Flash memory overwrite on modem fleet and loss of network access
Single consumer-oriented partition affected; satellite and directly managed government/mobility users not directly impacted
Network stabilization, distributor coordination, factory reset/replacement modem logistics

case_scenarios.name: Focused malicious traffic from modems
case_scenarios.summary: Alle 03:02 UTC Viasat rileva traffico malevolo da modem SurfBeam2/SurfBeam2+ in Ucraina, con difficolta' per i modem legittimi a restare online.
case_scenarios.athena_focus: Detect su anomalie SATCOM, correlazione CTI e triage con operatore di ground segment.

case_scenarios.name: Management network intrusion via VPN misconfiguration
case_scenarios.summary: L'analisi Viasat indica un'intrusione ground-based tramite misconfiguration in un'appliance VPN, con accesso remoto al trusted management segment.
case_scenarios.athena_focus: Governance accessi, hardening identity, monitoraggio del segmento di gestione.

case_scenarios.name: Targeted management commands to modem fleet
case_scenarios.summary: L'attore usa accesso di gestione per eseguire comandi legittimi e mirati su molti modem residenziali contemporaneamente.
case_scenarios.athena_focus: Containment, fallback SATCOM, verifica comandi di gestione e change control.

case_scenarios.name: Flash memory overwrite and modem drop-off
case_scenarios.summary: I comandi distruttivi sovrascrivono dati chiave nella memoria flash dei modem, rendendoli incapaci di accedere alla rete.
case_scenarios.athena_focus: Impact virtual/physical, service restoration, replacement/factory reset.

case_scenarios.name: European spillover and recovery logistics
case_scenarios.summary: Impatto su migliaia di clienti in Ucraina e decine di migliaia in Europa; ripristino tramite stabilizzazione rete, reset o sostituzione modem.

case_scenarios.name: Scope limits and unaffected services
case_scenarios.summary: Viasat dichiara che l'incidente non ha colpito direttamente il satellite KA-SAT, altri network Viasat, utenti mobility/government direttamente gestiti o dati end-user.
case_scenarios.athena_focus: Bounded impact assessment and confidence scoring.

timeline.event: High volumes of focused malicious traffic detected from SurfBeam2/SurfBeam2+ modems in Ukraine.
Large numbers of modems across Europe exited the network over roughly 45 minutes.
Ground-based intrusion via VPN appliance misconfiguration into trusted management segment.
Network stabilized, affected modems reset or replaced, nearly 30,000 replacement modems shipped.

paper_alignment.framework_name: ATHENA: countermeAsures for THreat IntElligence in Multi-DomaiN operAtions framework
paper_alignment.research_gap: CTI and CRM workflows, organizational structures, intelligence processes, and tools remain siloed and are not natively integrated in MDO contexts.
paper_alignment.core_contribution: A multi-domain framework intersecting CTI and CRM through a fourth-order tensor model to conceptualize, develop, and deploy cyber countermeasures in MDOs.
key_messages: Cyber Threat Intelligence in Multi-Domain Environment
Cyber Risk Management in Multi-Domain Operations
Cyber attack countermeasures to mitigate emerging multi-domain attack scenarios

entity_layers.name: Source and evidence layer
entity_layers.purpose: Traccia fonti, osservazioni, livello di confidenza e limiti interpretativi.

entity_layers.name: Threat model layer
entity_layers.purpose: Modella lo scenario tramite Diamond Model: adversary, capability, infrastructure, victim.

entity_layers.name: ATHENA tensor layer
entity_layers.purpose: Rappresenta la relazione P x D x L x E -> CC e il vettore scenario x.

entity_layers.name: Scenario and case layer
entity_layers.purpose: Conserva scenari sperimentali, case study NATO/CCDCOE e sotto-scenari.

entity_layers.name: Decision and response layer
entity_layers.purpose: Calcola ranking, vincoli, motivazione human-in-the-loop e piano di risposta.

athena_tensor_model.relation: ATHENA: P x D x L x E -> CC
athena_tensor_model.tensor_space: T = V_P x V_D x V_L x V_E

interpretation.P: security process/control function, including govern, detect, respond, prevent
interpretation.D: defensive capability across cyber, land, sea, space, air
interpretation.L: cybersecurity level across organization, intelligence, tool
interpretation.E: effect dimension across cognitive, physical, virtual
interpretation.CC: cyber-oriented countermeasure class or concrete countermeasure

x_components.ca_exp: Observed or inferred offensive capability exposure by domain, normalized 0..1
x_components.l_v: Current/degraded security level across organization/intelligence/tool, scale 0..5
x_components.i_pos: Negative impact on cognitive/physical/virtual dimensions, normalized 0..1

mdo_extension.definition_rule: Every scenario can be described not only by ATHENA x=(co_v, ca_exp, l_v, i_pos), but also by NATO MDO context: domains, DIME instruments, mechanisms, synchronization and orchestration conditions.

experiment_lifecycle.description: Importa paper, fonte caso, CTI e vincoli operativi.
Costruisce Diamond Model e vettore ATHENA x.
Mappa scenario su framework esterni e assi P-D-L-E.
experiment_lifecycle.output: framework mapping and ATHENA tensor coordinates

experiment_lifecycle.description: Calcola rischio residuo e ranking delle contromisure.
Richiede validazione human-in-the-loop e registra override.
Aggiorna KB con lezioni apprese, evidenze e variazioni di peso.

conceptual_frameworks.name: A Unified Framework for NATO Multi-Domain Operations
conceptual_frameworks.author: Joao Reis, Joint Warfare Centre
conceptual_frameworks.method: Systematic Literature Review and Critical Appraisal Skills Program
conceptual_frameworks.purpose: Clarifies NATO MDO mechanisms by integrating operational domains with military and non-military instruments of power.

dime_instruments.diplomatic: Political alignment, alliance signalling, de-escalation and partner coordination.
dime_instruments.information: Narrative shaping, information superiority, public communication and cognitive effects.
dime_instruments.military: Cross-domain force employment across land, maritime, air, space and cyberspace.
dime_instruments.economic: Sanctions, industrial resilience, supply chain pressure and recovery prioritization.

mdo_mechanisms.name: Cross-domain integration
mdo_mechanisms.description: Deliberate combination of capabilities, effects and activities across domains so they act as a mutually reinforcing system.

mdo_mechanisms.name: Synchronization and convergence of effects
mdo_mechanisms.description: Alignment of actions across time, space and purpose to generate compound operational effects.

mdo_mechanisms.name: Coordination of military and non-military instruments of power
mdo_mechanisms.description: Integration of DIME instruments with military activities in contested and hybrid contexts.

mdo_mechanisms.name: Information and decision superiority
mdo_mechanisms.description: Fusion of data, intelligence and decision support to shorten decision cycles and improve situational awareness.

mdo_mechanisms.name: Agility and adaptability
mdo_mechanisms.description: Ability to redirect capabilities, resources and response posture as the operational environment changes.

mdo_mechanisms.name: Orchestration
mdo_mechanisms.description: Strategic and operational guidance that aligns domains, actors, resources and effects with intent.

operationalization_conditions: shared situational awareness across domains and stakeholders
political cohesion and authority alignment for DIME actions
decision-support tools for timing, sequencing and prioritization
training and doctrine for cross-domain initiative

kb_usage.definition_rule: Every scenario can be described not only by ATHENA x=(co_v, ca_exp, l_v, i_pos), but also by NATO MDO context: domains, DIME instruments, mechanisms, synchronization and orchestration conditions.
